description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the InfoProviderFactory class in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.messaging.monitoring.logs package. The tests verify the behavior of methods that create InfoProvider instances based on ExternalMessage, Signal, and headers, as well as an empty factory method.

classes.name: InfoProviderFactoryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for InfoProviderFactory, testing creation of InfoProvider instances from various input sources.

methods.name: forExternalMessage
methods.description: Tests creation of InfoProvider from an ExternalMessage containing headers with a correlation ID.

methods.name: forSignal
methods.description: Tests creation of InfoProvider from a Signal object, verifying included thing ID, correlation ID, and timestamp.

methods.name: forHeaders
methods.description: Tests creation of InfoProvider from headers map without associated message or signal.

methods.name: forExternalMessageWithHeaders
methods.description: Tests creation of InfoProvider from ExternalMessage with arbitrary headers.

methods.name: forExternalMessageWithTextPayload
methods.description: Tests creation of InfoProvider from ExternalMessage with a text payload.

methods.name: forExternalMessageWithBytePayload
methods.description: Tests creation of InfoProvider from ExternalMessage with a byte array payload, verifying Base64 encoding.

methods.name: forExternalMessageWithoutTextPayload
methods.description: Tests creation of InfoProvider from ExternalMessage with null text payload, expecting empty payload.

methods.name: forExternalMessageWithoutBytePayload
methods.description: Tests creation of InfoProvider from ExternalMessage with null byte payload, expecting empty payload.

methods.name: forSignalWithHeaders
methods.description: Tests creation of InfoProvider from a Signal with headers.

methods.name: forSignalWithPayload
methods.description: Tests creation of InfoProvider from a Signal, verifying payload serialization.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Tests creation of an InfoProvider with default or empty values.
